text:
ana_marketing: Kickoff for Zephyr launch assets. Need interview, 2 publishable quotes, legal signoff on a short release, and lead routing.

 tom_prod: I can take the interview Fri 9:30am PT. Prefer 20m recorded + 10m follow-ups.

 kevin_cs: Zephyr prefers Fri AM. They want to approve any quote and will only sign off on concrete numbers after their analytics review.

 ben_legal: Will draft a minimal release clause: “By replying APPROVE you confirm factual accuracy and grant Redwood permission to publish the selected quote.” Will post in the doc.

 ana_marketing: Draft teaser copy in the doc: two tones (product-first vs customer-outcome). Want to A/B on social.

 mike_sales: Once live, route form leads to sales@ and add tag `zephyr-launch`. Also create SF task with 48h SLA.

 deploybot: Automation created: form -> sales@ -> SF task (48h) tag=`zephyr-launch`. Test alert sent to mike_sales.

 tom_prod: Locked Fri 9:30am with Jordan (recording enabled). Calendar invite sent.

 kevin_cs: Jordan confirmed transcript review window: 24h. They will choose the final quote and must hit the release snippet to approve.

 ana_marketing: Action list: 1) Ben post release snippet in doc. 2) Tom run interview Fri 9:30am. 3) Kevin send transcript to Jordan within 24h. 4) Mike confirm routing works. 5) Ana will create two teaser variants and a one-slide takeaway. Back here after quote selection. :thumbsup:
